outputs.headline: Salah: Vaksin COVID-19 tidak mengandung microchip pelacak
outputs.summary: Vaksin COVID-19 tidak mengandung microchip atau alat pelacak apa pun, melainkan dirancang untuk merangsang sistem kekebalan tubuh.
outputs.what_post_claims: Vaksin COVID-19 mengandung microchip untuk melacak setiap orang yang sudah divaksin.
outputs.what_is_true: Vaksin COVID-19 tidak mengandung microchip atau alat pelacak. Vaksin hanya berfungsi untuk merangsang sistem kekebalan tubuh agar menghasilkan antibodi.
evidence_against: Pusat Pengendalian dan Pencegahan Penyakit AS (CDC) menyatakan bahwa vaksin COVID-19 tidak mengandung microchip dan tidak digunakan untuk melacak pergerakan orang.
Spesialis penyakit menular dan regulator kesehatan di AS dan Kanada mengonfirmasi bahwa vaksin COVID-19 yang disahkan tidak mengandung microchip atau alat pelacak.
Kementerian Komunikasi dan Informatika RI (Kominfo) menyatakan klaim mengenai vaksin COVID-19 yang mengandung microchip pelacak adalah hoaks.
outputs.sources_spoken: menurut Pusat Pengendalian dan Pencegahan Penyakit AS (CDC) dan Kementerian Komunikasi dan Informatika RI (Kominfo)
outputs.audio_script: Postingan ini mengklaim bahwa vaksin COVID-19 mengandung microchip untuk melacak setiap orang yang sudah divaksin. Klaim ini salah. Vaksin COVID-19 tidak mengandung microchip atau alat pelacak apa pun. Vaksin hanya berfungsi untuk merangsang sistem kekebalan tubuh agar menghasilkan antibodi. Kami sangat yakin dengan informasi ini. Informasi ini berasal dari Pusat Pengendalian dan Pencegahan Penyakit AS (CDC) dan Kementerian Komunikasi dan Informatika RI (Kominfo).

outputs.headline: False: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips to track people
outputs.summary: This claim is false because COVID-19 vaccines contain no microchips or tracking technology and serve only to build immune protection against disease.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that COVID-19 vaccines contain implanted microchips designed to track every person who receives them.
outputs.what_is_true: COVID-19 vaccines do not have microchips or any tracking devices. They are designed only to help your immune system fight the virus. Barcodes and tracking tags exist only on the external packaging to monitor vaccine shipments.
evidence_against: The US CDC confirmed that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips and cannot track personal movements.
AFP Fact Check reported that health authorities in North America found no microchips or tracking hardware in approved vaccines.
Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Information stated that tracking codes are only used on external boxes for delivery logistics, not inside injected doses.
outputs.sources_spoken: according to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, AFP Fact Check, and the Indonesian Ministry of Communication and Information
outputs.audio_script: A post claims that COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips to track everyone who gets the injection. This claim is false. COVID-19 vaccines contain absolutely no microchips or tracking devices of any kind. They are made solely to help your body produce antibodies and fight off sickness. Tracking barcodes are used only on the outer boxes to manage shipping logistics, not inside the liquid that is injected. We are very sure of this fact, according to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, AFP Fact Check, and Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Information.
card_lines: Claim: COVID-19 vaccines contain tracking microchips
Fact: Vaccines only build immunity and carry no chips
Source: US CDC and AFP Fact Check
